heading: top-center
name: 置中標題＋圓形圖片網格
desc: 上方置中的標題組往上跨過區塊交界，下方是置中、較窄的網格，每個項目是圓形圖片加短標題。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組。區塊本身不往上移，只有標題組往上移，跨在本區塊和上一個區塊的交界上：小標籤落在上一個區塊的範圍內，大標題的第一行壓在交界線上。本區塊要有自己的實色底色，而且和上一個區塊的底色不同（例如淺色底），交界線才看得出來；區塊上方用區塊內的上方留白（不是外距，也不是負邊距）容納往上移的標題組，這段留白的底色和上一個區塊相同、不能透明，整個區塊從上到下都不能透出底下的內容，也不能蓋到上一個區塊的內容。標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略。標題組下方是多個項目排成的網格，網格置中，寬度約佔畫面六成，明顯窄於頁面內容寬度；每列五個等寬的項目，最後一列不足時靠左排列。每個項目無外框：圓形裁切的圖片在上，所有圖片同一大小，下方置中放一段短標題（可多行）。
mobile: 結構不變，網格改為每列三個項目，橫跨頁面內容寬度，最後一列不足時靠左排列；標題組仍置中在網格上方。

en.name: Centered heading + circular image grid
en.desc: A centered heading group that crosses the section boundary above a centered, narrower grid of circular images with short titles.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered. The section itself is not pulled up; only the heading group is moved up so it straddles the boundary between this section and the previous one: the label sits within the previous section and the first line of the headline lies on the boundary line. This section has its own solid background color that differs from the previous section (for example a light tint) so the boundary is visible. The raised heading group sits in this section's own top padding (not an outer margin and not a negative margin); that padding uses the same background color as the previous section and is never transparent, so nothing underneath shows through anywhere in the section and nothing covers the previous section's content. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. Below the heading group is a grid of multiple items, centered and about six tenths of the viewport width, clearly narrower than the page content width; each row holds five equal-width items, and an incomplete last row is aligned left. Each item has no frame: an image cropped to a circle on top, all images the same size, with a short title (may wrap to multiple lines) centered below.
en.mobile: The structure stays the same, but the grid changes to three items per row, spanning the page content width, with an incomplete last row aligned left; the heading group stays centered above the grid.
